summary: Minimal, correct fix that guards against cursor.fetchone() returning None before subscripting, directly resolving the reported 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable error. Formatting changes are consistent with Django style; no regression or compatibility concerns.

issues.description: Reflowing the DELETE statement (switching to single quotes, single-line SQL) is incidental to the fix, but it matches Django's idiom and is trivial cosmetic churn.
